options.name: Now
options.line: The close-up tour ends on the guitar lying flat, and 02 comes straight after. No workshop.

options.name: On the Bench
options.line: The guitar lies on a bench under a lamp and builds itself as you scroll, from two blocks of raw wood to strings.

options.name: Twelve Weeks
options.line: One rod of light per week fills as you scroll. The waiting weeks fill dotted, so you see most of the time is waiting.

options.name: Where the Weeks Go
options.line: A sideways gallery, one picture per stage of the build, with a ruler of weeks drawing along the bottom.
